description:
Adds a VehicleMileage transaction involving the specified vehicle for the specified total miles or optionally for the QuickBooks calculated total miles if you supply the odometer start and end.

The `vehicle_mileage_add` wrapper from qbXML is also accepted. Returns the v2 request to send, and the webhook payload QuickBooks' answer arrives in (this operation's response_json: its data shape and the status codes to handle).

Possible errors (error.code / error.type; the call result explains each): 1030 unsupported_request, 3000 invalid_object_id, 3040 invalid_amount, 3070 string_too_long, 3120 object_not_found, 3140 invalid_reference, 3150 missing_element, 3175 in_use, 3176 locked, 3180 cannot_save, 3210 invalid_value, 3220 not_authorized, 3231 request_not_processed, 3250 feature_not_enabled, 3260 insufficient_permission, 3261 personal_data_access_denied, 3262 payroll_subscription_required, 3263 read_only_access, 3264 merchant_services_subscription_required, 3270 missing_posting_account

Odometer reading at the end of the trip. `odometer_start` and `odometer_end` must both be specified if `total_miles` isn’t specified.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`odometer_end`, `odometer_start`), or `total_miles`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

odometer_start.description:
Odometer reading at the start of the trip. `odometer_start` and `odometer_end` must both be specified if `total_miles` isn’t specified.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`odometer_end`, `odometer_start`), or `total_miles`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.

total_miles.description:
Total trip miles. If `total_miles` is specified, you can’t specify `odometer_start` and `odometer_end`.

Choose exactly one of: the set (`odometer_end`, `odometer_start`), or `total_miles`. Members of a set combine with each other, not with the other choices.
